## Description

### About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

### About the Role

The Ramp Travel team builds the travel booking and management platform built-in to Ramp. We build the capabilities that allows travelers to stay productive on the road: flight and hotel search, booking and checkout, our agentic travel assistant, and on-the-go mobile trip guidance. We also own the capabilities that ensure companies are spending their travel dollars effectively: travel policy evaluation, supplier and TMC integrations and benchmarking, and data insights.

Growing the sophistication and global reach of the Travel product is a top strategic priority at Ramp. The work this team does directly enables Ramp to to support some of the largest and most interesting customers in the world.

#### What You’ll Do

- Lead, mentor, coach, and grow the Ramp Travel engineering team (~6 engineers today).
- Own delivery across our travel management surfaces: search and inventory, quoting and repricing, checkout, policy evaluation, loyalty, post-booking servicing.
- Own reliability and correctness of a system dependent on third parties: supplier APIs, GDS and aggregator content, TMC and OBT integrations.
- Partner with Product, Design, Ops, Partnerships, and Sales on enterprise travel commitments.
- Set the team's practices for AI-assisted development and ship agentic booking features.
- Hire. The team is expected to grow.

#### What You'll Need

- 2+ years managing engineers, team size roughly 5 to 15.
- High levels of ownership. Comfortability taking difficult ambiguous problems and driving successful execution.
- Has built something 0→1 and then scaled it.
- Willing to be hands-on. This is a six-person team, and everyone at Ramp is a builder.
- Current enough technically to lead a design review and evaluate an architecture proposal.
- Strong product judgment and comfort talking to customers.
- Has owned a transactional system with external dependencies: booking, payments, marketplace, or logistics.

#### Preferred

- Corporate travel domain experience, such as: corporate online booking tools (OBTs), integrations with travel content sources (GDS/NDC), and front-end traveler experiences.
- Enterprise B2B fintech or T&E background.
- Has rolled out agentic dev tooling to a team, or shipped LLM-backed features.
